posts.name: Soumya Mukhopadhyay
posts.cooked:
I did not pass OPPE on 29th March 2025 and hence have been assigned re-OPPE today, however I may not be able to attend today.

So, according to grading doc, if I don’t attend today, will I be given I_OP grade with the following category (assuming T>40 after end term score) ?

image876×155 15.8 KB

posts.name: Soumya Mukhopadhyay
posts.cooked: Sir can I get a clarification here please. @sayan @Subendu

posts.name: Gunahon Ka Devta
posts.cooked:
yes bro you will be given I_op

and in the next term you have to complete all the BPTs and OPPE

and GA, Quiz1 and ET marks will be carried over

or you have an another option too
that is
if your scores are low in GA, Quiz 1 and End term then you can repeat the entire course

in case of repeating the entire course you will have to submit GA, Grpa and give Quiz 1 , OPPE and end terms too

but if your marks are good enough in quiz 1, GA and end terms then just go for the OPPE

here I grade represents “incomplete”

I_ope means incomplete OPPE
